summary: StealthGas Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, reporting its second quarter and six months 2026 financial and operating results via a press release dated September 2, 2026. The filing contains routine financial data: net income of $17.3 million, revenues of $42.9 million, fleet employment details, and liquidity metrics. No special-situation transaction is described; it is a standard earnings announcement. The report is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. This is not an event-driven special situation, and no deal terms or corporate actions are present.
